prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Bakezori, a living Japanese straw sandal yokai.
ANATOMY: ONE giant upright traditional straw zori sandal is the entire body, one large living eye in the woven sole, TWO arms and TWO legs sprouting from its edges [bakezori-c01,bakezori-c02,bakezori-c03,bakezori-c05]. Original dark thong straps; NO second eye, no humanoid torso, no teeth.
MOMENT: Run round a dark inhabited house at night, one bare foot striking the wooden floor toward camera and the other behind, two arms swept wide, sole tilted forward; straw fibres and ordinary dust kick up. Eye wide and uncanny, not cute.
POWER: Nighttime household haunting by running and chanting [bakezori-c06]; no written chant or magic, no attack on humans, usually harmless [bakezori-c07].
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; tight close camera, subject fills square, no undocumented giant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant amber lantern or low moon, deep walnut shadows, hard rim light; physically ordinary dust or rain appropriate to scene.
SURFACE: tactile weathered skin, coarse cloth, straw, wood or stone; premium painted detail, no plastic.
SETTING: Japanese household wooden corridor at night [bakezori-c06].
MOOD: deeply uncanny, imposing and active; never cute, calm or decorative. Preserve helpful beings as helpful.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, inscription, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glowing aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.
depicted_variant: Bakezori, a living Japanese straw sandal yokai

visual_requirements.description: Living straw sandal with one eye and limbs; giant sandal variant
Running through inhabited house at night, harmless haunting

aura: Documented form and action dominate through low framing and physical light; no aura.
artistic_choices: Exactly two arms/two legs chosen standard interpretation of limbs; no aggression or magic added; close floor camera makes harmless presence uncanny.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: one straw sandal body with original thong straps, exactly one eye, two arms/hands and two running legs; no human torso or extra face. Imposing floor-level running moment, rough woven texture and single unblinking eye, harmless spooking preserved; no text or aura. All seven Sangar criteria pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px + 200px. A living woven-straw zori sandal with the black cloth hanao thong across the top and exactly one large central eye (c02), two straw arms and two straw legs, mid-run across the wooden floor of a lantern-lit Japanese house at night (c05/c06). Uncanny rather than cute — extreme low angle, lunging toward the viewer, the single wrong eye — and non-aggressive per c07; no invented teeth/attack or aura. The single eye and straw weave read unmistakably at 200px; no text or borrowed design.
